catalog.title: Zeenat Embroidered Pakistani Kurti
catalog.fabric: Pure Raw Silk with Organza Lace Trims
catalog.desc: Tailored royal ivory raw silk Pakistani kurti accented with heirloom gold zardozi adda embroidery, intricate hand-cut lace sleeve trims, and pearl button plackets.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Gulmohar Chanderi Kurta Set
catalog.desc: Delicate dusty rose organza adorned with fine metallic badla and antique marodi needlecraft. Paired with straight-cut brocade trousers and scalloped veil.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Aura Champagne Flared Gown
catalog.desc: Contemporary architectural drape meeting traditional hand-embroidery. A 32-meter flare cut structured for gala celebrations and grand occasions.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Sheesh Mahal Bridal Lehenga
catalog.desc: Inspired by the mirrored halls of Amber Fort. Encased in genuine semi-precious bead embroidery, beaten metallic cord, and a dual tissue veil.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Gul-e-Rana Velvet Pakistani Kurti
catalog.fabric: Micro Velvet with Pure Silk Lining
catalog.desc: Opulent forest emerald micro-velvet silhouette enriched with antique metallic tilla cord, dabka floral bouquets, and scalloped hem border work.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Mumtaz Anarkali Ensemble
catalog.desc: 32 Kalis of handcrafted shadow-work Chikankari interspersed with silver mukaish dots that catch the light at every graceful turn.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Pashmina Heritage Dupatta
catalog.desc: Featherlight warmth woven from Himalayan capra hircus fleece, detailed with single-needle botanical jaal borders.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Rangkat Brocade Unstitched Brocade
catalog.desc: Rare artisanal yardage crafted on hand-shuttle looms with alternating warp threads. Tailorable for bespoke lehengas or sherwanis.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Noor Organza Festive Pakistani Kurti
catalog.desc: Weightless blush peach tissue organza Pakistani kurti featuring hand-placed pearl droplets, gossamer cutwork sleeves, and fine badla embroidery.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Vasant Garden Floral Lehenga
catalog.desc: A springtime dream composed of thousand-petal floral tapestries rendered in ombré pastel threads, crowned by an embroidered sweetheart bustier.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Mehrunissa Draped Kaftan Set
catalog.desc: Effortless luxury designed for intimate soirees. Relaxed silhouette cinched with an ornate hand-beaded bullion belt.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L

catalog.title: Zari Buti Handloom Fabric Set
catalog.desc: Includes 5 meters of pure chanderi with woven golden bootis alongside 2.5 meters of dyed satin lining and a matched organza drape.
catalog.sizes: Custom Bespoke, Standard S, Standard M, Standard L
